title: Your Little Offer Kit
version: 1.1 (PDF footer: 'Version 1.1 · October 2026'); JSON has no version field
content_summary: Walks a beginner from idea to a live US$7-27 digital product on Gumroad in one weekend (or four evenings). Gives 25 example ideas, a four-question 1-5 scoring worksheet (14+ = good weekend project, below 12 = narrow it) and a one-sentence promise formula. Includes an hour-by-hour weekend plan, an outline template, simple design rules, file-format guidance and a quality checklist. Covers pricing tiers and five steps to a price, Gumroad setup and fees (FACT/UNKNOWN labelled, checked Oct 2026), and templates for product description, receipt, refund note and sales page. Ends with 5 launch posts, 5 story slides, 3 DMs, a launch email, after-launch measurement and a sources table. JSON and PDF match: every JSON string appears in the PDF; the PDF adds only cover, contents, section numbers and the legal/refund footer.

The weekend plan, hour by hour
Build it: outline, design and file formats

DMs for people who ask, and an email to your people
After launch: measure, improve or move on

title: Side Income Money System
version: 1.1 (PDF footer: 'Version 1.1 · October 2026'); JSON has no version field
content_summary: Guide to an accompanying spreadsheet (Start here, Income log, Expense log, Tax set-aside, Monthly summary, Year-end checklist) for tracking side-income money. Explains setting up a separate account and a receipts system, and lists the income and expense log columns (business amount = total x business-use %).
